title: The unit and counit in an adjoint triple are invertible together
statement: Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be categories [def-nagata-category] and let $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$, $G:\mathcal B\to\mathcal A$, and $H:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be functors. Given adjunctions $F\dashv G$ and $G\dashv H$ (that is, bijections $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal B}(Fa,b)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(a,Gb)$ and $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(Gb,a)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal B}(b,Ha)$ natural in $a,b$), let $\eta:\operatorname{id}_{\mathcal A}\to GF$ be the unit of the first and $\varepsilon:GH\to\operatorname{id}_{\mathcal A}$ the counit of the second. Then $\eta$ is a natural isomorphism if and only if $\varepsilon$ is a natural isomorphism.
